title: Verify audio and Recent report channel parity
changes: Record menu and command-console report checks for audio and Recent windows alongside existing CLI evidence.
validation: In an isolated EUR Wine/Xvfb session, the menu and interactive command console each saved one-frame audio and Recent captures. Audio reports retained the selected frame limit, Recent reports retained the active settings, and each report recorded the endpoint state; save left guest frame, clock, registers, keys and state hash unchanged. Recent used on-error off. All four reports were distinct, protected inputs verified and GUI closed normally.
limitations: CLI report evidence was established separately. This covers one EUR interpreter seed, simulated input and Recent on-error off; native Windows, physical input, other settings and complete DBG2-13 parity remain unverified.
